title: A zoom callout fills the space between its two lines with a faint tint of the line colour
goal: The two lines that join a zoom callout's source box to its magnified box enclose a band of space. Fill that band with the line colour at 10% opacity by default, so the callout reads as one beam from the source to the magnifier; the fill's opacity is adjustable (and can be set to 0 to turn it off).
notes:
User's words (2026-10-13): "the zoom lens has lines connecting the closest edge of the target to the closest edge of the zoom. I'd like the area in between to be filled the line color but be 10% opacity (configurable)." ('zoom lens' here is the zoom callout: source box, magnified box, two leader lines.)

From code reading (not run): leader lines come from PhotonzCore Geometry.leaderLines(source:callout:) and the turned variant (Geometry.swift:334-360, nearest corners); drawn by PhotonzRender/ZoomCalloutOverlayRasterizer.swift (:66) and previewed in Sources/Photonz/CanvasAnnotationPreview.swift (:392). ZoomCalloutContent (PhotonzCore/Layer.swift:752) has sourceRect, magnification, shape; add a fill opacity (Codable default). The band polygon is the two leader segments' endpoints in order; for circles use the external tangents.
acceptance: The band is the area bounded by the two leader lines and the facing sides of the source box and the magnified box (for a circle callout, the area between the two tangent lines), drawn UNDER both boxes so it never tints the magnified picture or the source area
Its colour is the callout's line colour at a new Fill opacity, default 10%, shown in the callout's appearance controls as a slider (0 to 100%) next to the line colour; 0 hides it

It follows the callout live while moving or resizing either box, rotating the callout, and changing its shape (rectangle or circle), with no gaps at the corners (the band's edges sit exactly on the leader lines, MEASURED within 1 px)
Export, copy and the canvas match; old callouts open with the band at the default 10% (or, if the audit argues old documents should not change, at 0 with new callouts at 10%, stated in the audit)
The Callout style in the Library carries the fill opacity for new callouts
A walk makes a callout, checks a pixel inside the band is the line colour blended at about 10%, sets Fill opacity to 0 and checks the band is gone, and photographs both
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Adversarial review before building: no mock page covers the callout band. App gap found: on a Circle callout the leader lines ran between the bounding-box CORNERS and dangled in space off both circles (reproduced in a walk capture), so a band between them could never sit on the circles. Fixed by making circle lines the two external tangents (convex hull bridges of the two capsule outlines, 48 steps per quarter arc; turned callouts via Geometry.boxPlacement(corners:)).

Built: ZoomCalloutContent.fillOpacity (0.1 for new, 0 when decoded from a file saved before it; audit argues old docs should not change), CalloutStyles.fillOpacity (tool memory), Geometry.leaderLines(shape:)/zoomCalloutBand/zoomCalloutOutline/boxPlacement in PhotonzCore/ZoomCalloutBand.swift, band drawn first in ZoomCalloutOverlayRasterizer with both shapes cut out by even-odd clips, creation-flight band (CanvasAnnotationPreview, masked CAShapeLayer inside the leader layer), Fill opacity slider in MagnifierSettingsRows behind new flag next-callout-band (Next default on; Current has no control and makes callouts with 0). Walk step expectCallout gained band: reads the rendered pixel against the same render with the band off.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 13042 tests green; band edge MEASURED within 1px of each leader line, rectangle and circle (ZoomCalloutOverlayTests.theBandsEdgeSitsOnTheLeaderLine); walk a-zoom-callout-band (Next defaults, no flags) green: 10% blend read when made, moved and made round, 0 after pressing the slider at its left end by its face, undo restores 10%, next callout drawn at the remembered 0. Related walks green: a-dragged-lens-leaves-no-trail, a-zoom-callout-keeps-its-shape, callout-crowding, callout-ring-color, callout-shape, callout-magnification, magnify-lens, dock-picked-first, every-panel-keeps-its-margins, dock-fits-the-window, tool-settings-capsule. Export and copy: by code path only (both render callouts through DocumentRenderer, which passes fillOpacity); not walked. Library: there is no Callout style tile in the Library; the callout tool's own memory (CalloutStyles) is what carries the fill for new callouts.

Left rough (in the audit, not filed: each is a judgement question already put to the user in the audit's evaluate list, so their reaction files it): Fill opacity placed in the Lens section rather than beside the line colour; old documents open at 0; the circle tangent-line fix reaches Current through the shared renderer; a diagonally placed rectangle callout gives a thin triangular band because both nearest-corner lines meet at one box corner.

Zoom callouts tint the band between their two lines with the line colour, 10% by default for new callouts in Next (files saved before open at 0); Fill opacity slider in the Lens section under Shape, one undo step per pull, remembered by the tool; Circle callouts now draw the two touching lines and the band stops at both round edges.
